note: Historical experimental target only. It was not deployed or validated and must not be described as the submitted architecture. The canonical v0.6 source is accuracy_first_manifest.json: SYS.UserQuery -> Official Case Intake -> signed internal run context -> strictly serial tool-free Agents -> deterministic Gate -> one End.

Evidence Collection Agent.handoff_description: Prepares a version-pinned shared evidence package and reports evidence gaps.

Rider Advocate.handoff_description: Represents the rider's position, gathers rider-side evidence, and argues for rider-favorable outcomes.

Driver Advocate.handoff_description: Represents the driver's position, gathers driver-side evidence, and argues for driver-favorable outcomes.

Policy & Precedent Agent.handoff_description: Retrieves applicable policy and reviewer-approved precedents, supplying advisory context.

Judge.handoff_description: Weighs both arguments, applies policy, and issues a recommendation with a confidence score and explanations.

workflow_nodes.purpose: Parse and validate one unescaped Judge JSON object; fail closed on malformed output.

server_side_authorization.note: Unchanged fail-closed allowlist. Unauthorized operations return HTTP 403 and are audited.

responsibilities: evidence membership, provenance, checksum, input fingerprint
allowed action type, fee item, currency, ledger-derived amount
exact agreement between Judge recommendation and program-allowed status/action

acceptance_checks: The ADP application shows MULTI_AGENT mode.
Every Agent except the Judge has a non-empty tool list.
Each Agent's tool calls appear under that Agent's own execution in the trace.
Rider and Driver call get_trip_evidence with different credentials and receive different request IDs.
Route Deviation and No-Show both complete end to end.
The Python deterministic gate accepts the Judge recommendation without repair.
The End output is a single unescaped JSON object.
No credential appears in model-visible data or exported logs.
